# Solver CLI — Command Reference

Complete, always-current reference for every `node scripts/solve.js`
subcommand. Ground truth is the dispatch map in
[`scripts/solve.js`](../../../scripts/solve.js); descriptions live in the
curated sidecar [`../solve-commands.json`](../solve-commands.json). See
[`boot.md`](boot.md) for first commands and [`core.md`](core.md) for the
guardrail command map.

| Command | Purpose | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `new` | Create a versioned Quest draft under solve/quests/<id>.json. Drafting is not sealing: the first execution command lints and declares it. Link flags author the planning graph without hand-editing JSON; --force is refused once append-only history exists. | `node scripts/solve.js new --id <id> --statement "<sealed result>" [--class product|process] [--plan-doc <path>] [--parent-quest <id>] [--roadmap-row <id>] [--spec-ref <ref>] [--closes-cl <CL-id>] [--inherit-rulesout-from <parentQuestId>]` |
| `run` | Run the Quest loop toward SOLVED/EXHAUSTED. Bare `run --id <id>` uses the default `dry` executor (a no-op skeleton — it prints a banner saying so); real autonomous work needs `--executor agent --yes`. Add `--keep-alive` to replay only progress-bearing MAX_CYCLES boundaries; judgment and repair stops return once with a typed action. | `node scripts/solve.js run --id <id> --executor agent --yes --keep-alive [--max 20]` |
| `status` | Show the current Quest state: active frontier, rung, and recent movement. | `node scripts/solve.js status --id <id>` |
| `report` | Project the event log into the terminal report / closure projection. | `node scripts/solve.js report --id <id>` |
| `portfolio` | Cross-Quest portfolio view and meta-ratio over all quests. | `node scripts/solve.js portfolio` |
| `frontier` | Render the frontier board; `--write` persists it to solve/FRONTIER.generated.md (the durable boot board). | `node scripts/solve.js frontier [--write]` |
| `overview` | Live roadmap -> epic -> spec -> quest -> ledger overview; `--write` persists it. | `node scripts/solve.js overview [--write]` |
| `trace` | Cross-layer planning trace joining quests via their `links` block. Pass exactly one selector. | `node scripts/solve.js trace --row <id> | --cl <CL-#> | --spec <ref> | --quest <id>` |
| `handoff` | Compute the scope-safe git pathspec for committing exactly one terminal Quest; dry-run by default, `--commit` executes only after the full audit and aggregate source approval pass. | `node scripts/solve.js handoff --id <id> [--commit]` |
| `checkpoint` | At an explicit durability boundary, commit the one exact scope-clean landing candidate after approval. Version 2 requires a named boundary reason; routine attempts do not checkpoint. Never pushes. | `node scripts/solve.js checkpoint --id <id> --reason <handoff|risky-tree|long-running|milestone> [--dry-run]` |
| `invariants` | Tier-2 live-evidence verification of architecture invariants (the standing dual of doneWhen): derive HELD/BREACHED/UNGUARDED for entries in architecture/contracts/invariants.json that carry a liveEvidence block, as a fold over the Solver event log. Always active (unconditional). | `node scripts/solve.js invariants [--evaluate] [--json] [--changed a,b | --since <ref>] [--score] [--export [--out <path>]]` |
| `probe` | Run a registered probe directly over real artifacts and print its JSON result; the Solver trusts probes, not self-report. Takes no --id and does no quest resolution — every argument other than --probe is passed through to the probe itself. | `node scripts/solve.js probe --probe <scenario-harness|oracle|invariantHeld> [probe-specific args...]` |
| `finding` | Record durable knowledge in the append-only Quest log. Exact verifier approvals and rejections bind subagent evidence to a content fingerprint; recording either verdict never commits. | `node scripts/solve.js finding --id <id> --frontier <f> --claim "<learning>" [--kind repro-on-head|verifier-approval|verifier-rejection] [--rulesOut "<lever>"] [--evidence <ref>] [--verification-scope attempt|aggregate|both --verification-fingerprint sha256:<64hex>]` |
| `promote-finding` | Promote a recorded finding into in-repo steering as a rule (then regenerate with `npm run steering:llm:pack`). | `node scripts/solve.js promote-finding --id <id> --frontier <f> --domain <architecture|testing|governance|style>` |
| `override` | Recorded-reason escape hatch: authorize one bypass of an overridable guard (only the heuristic theory/scope guards; never honesty/integrity invariants). Requires a falsifiable --reason. | `node scripts/solve.js override --id <id> --frontier <f> --guard <theory|scope> --reason "<justification>"` |
| `reflect` | Record a reflection think-cycle (no attempt, no metric claim): micro by default, or `--altitude` to question the frame. `--note` is required. | `node scripts/solve.js reflect --id <id> --note "<text>" [--frontier <fid>] [--altitude]` |
| `step` | Begin a supervised attempt: pins the frontier and prints the rung dossier. Records nothing until `--commit` (or `--abort` to discard the pending attempt). At commit time, `--auto-diff` snapshots `git diff` against the pin recorded at step begin into solve/changes/<id>/attempt-<n>.diff and uses it as the changeRef (errors if nothing changed; solver-generated bookkeeping — solve/FRONTIER.generated.md, solve/state, solve/log, solve/report — is excluded from the snapshot; an explicit --changeRef takes precedence and prints a warning that --auto-diff was ignored). | `node scripts/solve.js step --id <id> [--commit (--changeRef diff:<path> | --auto-diff) --summary "<what changed>" | --abort]` |
| `step-pending` | Print the pending supervised step (the pinned baseline attempt awaiting a commit) as JSON. | `node scripts/solve.js step-pending --id <id>` |
| `next` | Typed "what do I do next?" projection: folds pending-step state, the last recorded stop, the current-blocker card, advisories, and the exact checkpoint-readiness dossier. It delegates only structurally checkpoint-landable source candidates and distinguishes executable-command, command-template, manual-action, and terminal actions. Use --json for the stable machine-readable projection. | `node scripts/solve.js next --id <id> [--json]` |
| `doctor` | Read-only operator preflight. Reports Git/worktree state, absent/malformed/disabled/enabled local agent configuration, live adapter executability, the no-op example adapter, attribution validity, and the recommended autonomous or supervised mode. Use --json for the stable machine-readable report. | `node scripts/solve.js doctor [--json]` |
| `lint` | Read-only Quest authoring validation. --id checks one Quest; --all reports the versioned/legacy census without rewriting historical Quest files or logs. | `node scripts/solve.js lint (--id <id> | --all) [--json]` |
| `theory` | Two-layer (system + frontier) theory management used to break a stall: system, option, select, record, supersede, list, card, import-ledger. | `node scripts/solve.js theory <system|option|select|record|supersede|list|card|import-ledger> --id <id> ...` |
| `health` | Quest health diagnostics: stall, oscillation, and coupled-invariant signals that gate the theory/reflection rungs. | `node scripts/solve.js health --id <id>` |
| `ingest-evidence` | Stamp an external evidence artifact onto a frontier (or doneWhen) so a probe can read it. | `node scripts/solve.js ingest-evidence --id <id> --frontier <f> --evidence <path> [--probe doneWhen]` |
| `attempt` | Record a one-shot measured attempt that runs a harness command and captures the result as evidence. | `node scripts/solve.js attempt --id <id> --frontier <f> --changeRef diff:<path> -- <harness cmd...>` |
| `audit` | Run the Quest audit (scope and evidence-honesty checks) that gates a git handoff. | `node scripts/solve.js audit --id <id>` |
| `upgrade` | Idempotently append a `quest-upgraded` strict-audit baseline event to the Quest log, ingest any unrecorded evidence, and regenerate the report. | `node scripts/solve.js upgrade --id <id> [--reason "<text>"]` |
| `reopen` | Reopen a parked frontier whose exhaustion verdict was driven by non-measuring (invalid) samples; resets it to the first rung for honestly-measured attempts. `--reason` is required to justify the reopen; `--frontier` defaults when exactly one frontier is parked. | `node scripts/solve.js reopen --id <id> [--frontier <f>] --reason "<why>"` |
| `park` | Operator-decision terminal: park an open frontier as `exhausted` with provenance `operator` when an altitude reflection concluded PARK/EXHAUST-AND-PIVOT (frame refuted or sealed symptom absent on HEAD). Requires a prior `reflect --altitude` on the quest and a falsifiable --reason; appends the quest-level EXHAUSTED terminal when every frontier is parked exhausted. | `node scripts/solve.js park --id <id> [--frontier <f>] --reason "<why no honest remaining move exists>"` |
